notes.title: Nominate Submorse for the 2021 Steam Awards!
Inverted Mouse Support
notes.content: -You can now vertically invert your mouse via a checkbox in the options terminal.

notes.title: Small Framerate Change 4/22/2021
notes.content:
-Frames are now capped at 144 without VSync. 
*Vsync is still recommended to lower GPU usage.

notes.title: Fixed an issue involving the alphabet leaderboard scores
notes.content: -Fixed an issue involving the alphabet leaderboard scores not properly displaying.
